rewards.name: Skull Dragon

rewards.name: Monarch Dragon
rewards.description: If you see the Monarch Dragon gliding through the sky, summer has come. This creature loves nature, sprinkles lucky omen, and brings lots of color to the islands. Whatever you do, don’t try to trap it in a jar, this dragon loves to roam free.
